spans.s:
áhi, m. serpent; esp. the dragon of the sky,
often identified w. the demon Vritra. [see
under agha: cf. ἔχις, Lat. anguis, ‘serpent’;
 ἔγχελυς, Lat. anguilla, ‘cel.’]

áhi-gopā [352], a. having the dragon as
their keeper. [1302^1.]

ā́hitāgni, a. having a set or established
fire; as m. one who is keeping alive a
sacred fire. [āhita, √1dhā + ā, ‘set’:
1299a.]
